name: Crispy Cod with Lemon Parsley Sauce & Tomato-Arugula Panzanella Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut or tear bread into 2-inch pieces. Divide between two large baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 slices sourdough bread
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
9 tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl. Add flour and spices, then stir to combine the coating. (Reserve lemons for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Sprinkle with the coating on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add cod and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with cooled croutons, arugula, and capers, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and cod between plates or bowls. Spoon sauce over the cod and enjoy!
